name: tpl-chain-response-2-nogoal
task: Each time the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ChainResponse requires carrying the box on the step after each fall, and Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying it when reaching the exit.

texts: Whenever the box falls, be carrying it on the very next step.
If you reach the exit, be carrying the box.
